reasons: The opinion states that excessive-force analysis asks whether officers' actions are objectively reasonable in light of the facts and circumstances.
The opinion lists Kingsley factors and says the standard cannot be applied mechanically.
The Court said a per se rule for prone restraint of a resisting detainee would contravene its excessive-force precedent, then granted certiorari, vacated, and remanded.
residual_risks: The assertion should not be read to decide whether the Fourth or Fourteenth Amendment supplies the source of law; the opinion expressly declined that question.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: For maximum precision, say "objective-reasonableness inquiry under Graham/Kingsley factors" rather than only "Kingsley reasonableness factors."
